answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond tied to a verifiable history of completed work before it can transact. Like a pigment that cannot be washed off a surface, that history sticks to one identity and cannot be duplicated for free. When a bridge moves reputation between marketplaces, it checks the bond and history rather than trusting a new claim. At dawn of each settlement period, identities with proven work keep access, while a sybil attacker must fund and age every fake identity separately, making mass forgery expensive and slow.
